blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) typically relies on preference pairs generated from diverse model pools and ranked by an external LLM judge. The recently proposed delta-learning hypothesis suggests that comparable supervision can instead be obtained from a single pair of models by treating the larger model's response as preferred. We investigate the limits of this approach across model families and scales. We show, both theoretically and empirically, that fixed model pairs introduce systematic, generator-dependent biases that are predictive of the preference label independent of response quality. Consequently, DPO trained on single-pair data consistently underperforms multi-model preference data, despite the larger generator producing higher-quality responses, and we trace this gap to training dynamics consistent with reward hacking on these biases. We further show that simply increasing the number of generators, even without an external judge, is enough to partially mitigate this effect. Our results highlight generator diversity as a critical factor in preference-data construction.
blocks.zh: 直接偏好优化(DPO)一般依靠由多样模型集合产生的偏好配对,由外部LLM评委排名. 最近提出的三角学习假说表明,可以通过将更大的模型的反应作为首选,从一对模型中获取可比较的监督。 我们调查这一方法在模范家庭和规模中的局限性。 我们从理论上和经验上都表明,固定模型对子引入了系统化的、依赖生成器的偏差,这些偏好标签的预测独立于反应质量。 因此,DPO接受关于单页数据的培训,尽管较大的生成器能产生更高质量的响应,但多模式偏好数据的业绩始终不佳,我们追踪这一差距,使之与对这些偏见的奖励性黑客化相适应。 我们进一步表明,仅仅增加发电机数量,即使没有外部法官,也足以部分减轻这种影响。 我们的成果突出表明,发电机的多样性是优先数据构建的一个关键因素。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) ( Rafailov et al., 2024 ) is a widely adopted post-training technique for improving large language models (LLMs) across various tasks ( Liu et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025a ) . It remains highly relevant because it is computationally cheaper than on-policy learning, highly effective in non-verifiable domains, and provides a stronger foundational model than Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) alone for subsequent Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) OLMo et al. (2026) .
blocks.zh: 直接偏好优化(DPO)(Rafailov等人,2024年)是一种广泛采用的培训后技术,用于改进跨越各种任务的大型语言模型(LLMs)(刘等人,2024年;张等人,2025年a). 它仍然具有高度的相关性,因为它在计算上比政策性学习更便宜,在不可核查的领域非常有效,并且为随后的强化学习提供了比仅监督的精益求精(SFT)更强大的基础模型,用于可验证奖励(RLVR)OLMo等人(2026年).

blocks.en:
DPO requires a dataset of prompts, each paired with two completions of differing quality designated as “chosen” and “rejected”. The training process then optimizes the model to assign a higher probability to the chosen completion. Often, these completions are generated by other LLMs, and their relative quality is evaluated using an LLM-as-a-judge OLMo et al. (2025) ; Cui et al. (2024) .
However, this evaluation method is imperfect; judge preferences are often swayed by superficial factors like length ( Hu et al., 2025 ) , formatting ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) , or judge-generator distributional similarity ( Li et al., 2025 ) , introducing significant ranking instability ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) .
Given the critical need for high-quality data, extensive research has focused on mitigating these biases Park et al. (2024) , developing data-aware training algorithms ( Wu et al., 2024 ) , refining data cleaning techniques ( Yeh and Li, 2025 ; Gao et al., 2025 ) , and evaluating the alignment between data pairs and trained models ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
DPO需要一套由提示组成的数据集,每个数据集配对两个质量不同的完成,指定为“选择”和“拒绝”。 培训过程然后优化模型,为选定的完成分配更高的概率。 这些完成通常由其他有限责任公司产生,其相对质量使用LLM-as-judge OLMo等人(2025);Cui等人(2024)。
然而,这种评价方法并不完善;法官偏好往往受到表面因素的影响,如长度(Hu et al.,2025),格式化(Zhang et al.,2025b),或法官-生成者分布相似(Li et al.,2025),造成了重大的排名不稳定(Zhao et al.,2026).
鉴于对高质量数据的迫切需要,广泛研究的重点是减轻这些偏差Park等人(2024年),开发数据认知培训算法(Wu等人,2024年),完善数据清理技术(Yeh and Li,2025年;Gao等人,2025年),并评价数据对称与培训模型的对称性(Zhang等人,2026年)。

blocks.en: As an alternative, Geng et al. (2025) proposed the “Delta Learning hypothesis,” suggesting that ranking can be determined using just two models without external supervision. Thus, preference pairs are generated directly from a single model pair within the same family and lineage: a larger model for the chosen and a smaller one for the rejected. Contrary to Pan et al. (2025) , they show how the chosen model doesn’t need to be stronger than the trained model, provided there is a sufficient quality delta between the completions and minimal noise . This method often aligns with judge preferences and drives comparable improvements. The Olmo3 developers also utilized this approach, demonstrating that LLM-as-a-judge data and the delta heuristic provide complementary signals rather than one being strictly superior OLMo et al. (2026) . Furthermore, Lee et al. (2026) expanded on this by investigating the single-pair method’s impact on reasoning models and Chain-of-Thought (CoT) improvements. Despite these findings, little is known about how this hypothesis generalizes across different model families and scales. A critical open question remains: is the noise that can overwhelm the delta learning signal merely occasional correctness errors, as originally assumed, or can it take a more systematic, generator-dependent form that persists regardless of scale or dataset size?
blocks.zh: 作为替代办法,Geng等人(2025年)提出了"Delta Learning suppose",建议可以使用两个模型来决定排名,而无需外部监督. 因此,首选配对直接来自同一家族和家族内部的单一型号配对:被选中的型号较大,被否决的型号较小. 与Pan等人(2025年)相反, 他们表示所选模型不需要比训练有素的模型更强大, 这种方法往往与法官的偏好一致,推动类似的改进。 Olmo3开发者也使用这种方法,表明LLM-as-a-judgedate数据与三角洲热力学提供了互补信号,而不是一个完全优越的OLMo等人(2026年). 此外,Lee等人(2026年)通过调查单派方法对推理模型和 " 思考链 " 改进的影响,对此进行了扩展。 尽管有这些发现,但对于这个假设如何概括到不同的模范家庭和尺度却所知甚少. 一个关键的未决问题仍然是:能够覆盖三角洲学习信号的噪音是否只是原先假设的偶发正确性错误,还是能够采取一种系统化的、依赖生成器的形式,不管规模大小或数据集大小,都持续存在?

blocks.en: In this work, we present a comprehensive theoretical and empirical study comparing the two approaches. We theoretically prove that relying on a single model pair increases reward hacking by exploiting generator-dependent spurious features, and empirically confirm this mechanism through both the reward-accuracy gap in training dynamics and the classification accuracy achieved by a classifier observing only style features of chosen and rejected. Consistent with this analysis, we further demonstrate that single-pair DPO systematically underperforms relative to using multiple pairs. Finally, we show that increasing generator diversity alone, without an external judge, partially mitigates this effect for most models tested, providing a better judge-free baseline for constructing preference pairs from a model pool.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们提出了比较两种方法的全面理论和经验研究。 我们从理论上证明,依靠单一的模型对通过利用依赖发电机的假象特性来增加奖励黑客,从经验上通过训练动力学的奖励-准确性差距和一个只观察所选择和拒绝的风格特性的分类员所达到的分类精度来证实这个机制. 根据这一分析,我们进一步表明,相对于使用多种配对而言,单配对DPO系统表现不佳。 最后,我们表明,单靠发电机的多样性,没有外部法官,就能够部分减轻对大多数被测试模型的影响,为从模型库中建造首选配对提供了更好的无法官基线。

blocks.en: For a fixed pair, the propensity gap is constant not just on dataset-wide average but within every domain : it does not depend on x x beyond which domain x x falls in, and does not average out as | 𝒟 | → ∞ |\mathcal{D}|\to\infty . This matters because intuitively spurious features are often domain-specific — e.g., \boxed{} or # markers in math — so a small marginal gap Δ f ​ ( θ c , θ r ) \Delta_{f}(\theta_{c},\theta_{r}) can mask large, opposite-signed, domain-conditional gaps that cancel only in aggregate. Since prompt domain is itself an observable covariate rather than a spurious feature the policy needs to ignore, this marginal cancellation offers no protection: a model can condition on domain implicitly and still exploit the domain-local shortcut in each region of the prompt distribution. This directly explains why, empirically, chosen and rejected completions from a single pair can become trivially separable using only surface-level features; we confirm this in Section 3.3.3 , where fixed model pairs differing sharply in a domain-specific stylistic propensity yield a very strong classifier. The same conditioning argument extends to the following Proposition 2 : pooling attenuates the bias only insofar as generator identity varies within each domain, not merely across the dataset as a whole.

blocks.en: 2.3 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 2.3 实验设置

blocks.en: 2.3.1 Training

To study the limitations of generating preference pairs from only two models, we adapt the DPO dataset used for OLMo2-1B-SFT ( OLMo et al., 2025 ) olmo2-1b-prefmix , which originally relied on completions from multiple models ranked by an LLM-as-a-judge. To enable a direct 1-to-1 comparison, we re-generate all completions using models spanning various parameter sizes and model families. Following the heuristic in Geng et al. (2025) , we assign the chosen ( y c y_{c} ) and rejected ( y r y_{r} ) completions based strictly on the parameter size of the generating models.
blocks.zh: 为了研究只从两个模型产生偏好对的局限性,我们调整了OLMo2-1B-SFT(OLMo等人,2025年) olmo2-1b-prefmix所使用的DPO数据集,该数据集最初依赖于由LLM-as-a-judge排名的多个模型的完成. 为了能够直接进行1比1的比较,我们利用跨越不同参数大小和模范家庭的模型重新生成所有完成. 在Geng等人(2025年)的heuristic之后,我们严格根据生成模型的参数大小来指定所选的(y c y y _{c})和拒绝的(y r y_{r})完成.

blocks.en: We run one thousand training steps with a batch size of 128, sweeping learning rates and β \beta hyperparameters. We select the final ( β \beta , learning rate) configurations based on average downstream benchmark performance of a separate unseen evaluation set. We use the length-normalized loss defined in Equation 1 , which has been shown to outperform the original formulation and alleviate length bias ( Lambert et al., 2025 ) . More details are provided in Appendix E .
blocks.zh: 我们运行了一千个训练步骤, 批量大小为128, 粗略的学习率和β\β超参数。 我们根据单独一套未见评价的下游平均基准业绩选择最终配置(β\β,学习率)。 我们使用第1方程式中定义的长度正常损失(Lambert等人,2025年)。 详见附录E。

blocks.en: 2.3.2 Models and Evaluation
blocks.zh: 2.3.2 模式和评价

blocks.en: We select the training models and evaluation benchmarks according to three criteria. First, we aim to study models for which the preference signal is informative: the trained models should be strong enough to learn from the generated preference pairs, but not so strong that performance on the downstream benchmarks is already saturated. Second, we seek diversity in the models used to construct preference pairs, in order to test whether the conclusions depend on a particular model family or parameter scale. Third, we want the evaluation suite to reflect the capabilities relevant to the original dataset while also covering a broader range of skills and not saturated.
blocks.zh: 我们根据三个标准选择培训模式和评价基准。 首先,我们的目标是研究偏好信号能提供信息的模型:训练有素的模型应该足够强大,能够从产生的偏好对学习,但并不那么强大,以至于下游基准的性能已经饱和. 其次,我们寻求在用于构建偏好对的模型中的多样性,以测试结论是取决于特定的模型家族还是参数尺度. 第三,我们希望评价套件反映与原始数据集有关的能力,同时涵盖更广泛的技能,而不是饱和。

blocks.en: We therefore select models along two dimensions: capability and diversity . In terms of capability, we focus on models with performance broadly comparable to OLMo2-1B-SFT , the model for which the dataset’s prompt distribution was originally designed. In terms of diversity, we include models from different families and parameter scales. Thus, we consider the following Hugging Face checkpoints: Qwen2-1.5B-Instruct ( Yang et al., 2024 ) , Gemma2-2B-it ( Team et al., 2024 ) , Aya-23-8B ( Aryabumi et al., 2024 ) , and Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2 ( Jiang et al., 2023 ) , Qwen1.5-4B-Chat and Qwen1.5-7B-Chat ( Team, 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 因此,我们按照两个方面选择模式:能力和多样性。 在能力方面,我们侧重于性能与OLMo2-1B-SFT大致相当的模型,最初设计了数据集的快速分布模型. 在多样性方面,我们包括来自不同家庭和参数尺度的模型。 因此,我们认为以下是 " 拥抱面 " 检查站: Wen2-1.5B-指令(杨等人,2024年),Gemma2-2B-it(Team等人,2024年),Aya-23-8B(Aryabumi等人,2024年),以及Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2(Jiang等人,2023年),Quen1.5-4B-Chat和Quen1.5-7B-Chat(Team,2024年).

blocks.en: We use a staged approach to selecting generator models. First, we conduct preliminary experiments with Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-0.6B , which provide a cost-effective setting while maintaining a meaningful parameter gap, following the 2-3B parameter differences used in Geng et al. (2025) . We then test the robustness of our findings across model families and parameter scales, using model size as the heuristic for constructing preference pairs always within the same family where larger parameter count reliably predicts benchmark performance within that lineage as done in the reference work. Finally, we expand the generator pool beyond two models to investigate whether sampling completions from multiple models can improve performance under the same size-based preference heuristic. The specific models used in each experiment are described in the corresponding results sections, with the complete list provided in Appendix D.2 .
blocks.zh: 我们采用分阶段的方法来选择发电机模型。 首先,我们先用Quen3-4B和Quen3-0.6B进行初步实验,这些实验提供了成本效益高的设定,同时在Geng等人(2025年)中使用的2-3B参数差异之后保持了有意义的参数差距. 然后,我们测试我们的调查结果在模范家庭和参数尺度上的稳健性,使用模型大小作为在同一个家庭中构建首选配对的热度,因为较大的参数可以可靠地计算出基准线内的业绩,就像参考工作所做的那样。 最后,我们把发电机池扩大到两个模型之外,以调查多个模型的采样完成能否在同样大小的偏好heuristic下提高性能. 每个实验中采用的具体模型在相应的结果部分中描述,完整的清单见附录D.2.

To select the best hyperparameters we use the training set of GSM8K, the validation set of ARC-Challenge and IFBench ( Pyatkin et al., 2025 ) since IFEval lacks separate split. Detailed evaluation settings are provided in Appendix Table 4 ; Appendix Table 5 confirms that performance does not saturate on these benchmarks across the model scales considered.

blocks.en: Since neither the data distribution nor the choice of model generators appears to be entirely responsible for the low performance of DPO, we next conduct an analysis of the generated data and the training dynamics. In Section 2.2 , we theoretically showed that spurious features are more likely to emerge when data are generated from a small number of model pairs rather than from a larger and more diverse pool of generators. In this section, we empirically investigate this phenomenon and show that, for some tasks, such biases can become particularly pronounced.
blocks.zh: 由于数据分布和模型生成器的选择似乎都没有完全造成DPO的低性能,我们接下来对生成的数据和培训动态进行分析. 在第2.2节中,我们从理论上表明,当数据来自少量的模型对而不是来自更大和更多样化的发电机组时,假象特征更有可能出现。 在本节中,我们实证地研究了这一现象,并表明就某些任务而言,这种偏见可能变得特别明显。

blocks.en: If the signal learned from the single-pair data is primarily attributable to the intended preference between y w y_{w} and y l y_{l} , we would therefore expect its training dynamics to be comparable to those obtained from the model pool and judge. Figure 3 shows the opposite: it reports averages across the models, generator pairs, and learning rates considered in Section 3.1 , with reward accuracy differing by approximately 27 % 27\% between the two settings. This substantial gap suggests that the single-pair construction exposes additional systematic signals beyond the intended preference, causing reward hacking and hindering training improvement.

blocks.en: We focus on data from one of the Olmo2 pair with minimal length bias that still produces sub-par downstream performance, and another pair used to highlight how extreme and problematic this bias can become.
blocks.zh: 我们关注的是其中一对Ollmo2的数据,其长度偏差最小,仍然产生下游亚帕性能,另外一对用来强调这种偏差会变成怎样的极端和问题.

blocks.en: We evaluate format bias on GSM8K by extracting stylistic features, such as bolding and hash delimiters, while excluding length, which was analysed previously and controlled via a length-normalized loss that alleviates this issue. One might worry that some markers belong to the expected answer format rather than being spurious. This does not undermine the analysis: if a marker is genuinely required by the task (e.g. "Write the answer after ###"), a well-calibrated signal should push the policy to always produce it, so it would appear in both chosen and rejected completions and carry no discriminative power. Its strong separability here instead indicates inconsistent use across completions which is a tracker for generator identity rather than task compliance.
blocks.zh: 我们评估GSM8K的格式偏差,方法是提取结构特征,如粗体和散列划定器,同时排除长度,而长度以前通过长度正常化损失进行分析和控制,从而缓解这一问题。 人们可能担心,有些标记属于预期的答案格式,而不是虚假的。 这不破坏分析:如果任务真正需要一个标记(如"在QQ之后写下答案"),一个经过精心校准的信号应该推动政策总是产生它,所以它会在所选择的和被拒绝的完成中都出现,并且没有带歧视性的力量. 其强烈的可分离性表明整个完成过程的使用不一致,而整个完成过程是跟踪生成器身份而不是任务合规。

blocks.en: To test if stylistic shortcuts drive reward hacking, we map completions to normalized style vectors and project them into 2D via PCA. As shown in Figure 4 , the features exhibit clear separability, with the first two principal components explaining 51.8 % 51.8\% and 57.1 % 57.1\% of the total variance in the first and second datasets, respectively. Moreover, a logistic regression classifier on these features achieves 5-fold CV AUROC of 83 % 83\% and 100 % 100\% . This indicates that stylistic features account for most of the structural variance between model outputs in this setting, consistent with their acting as a shortcut that drives the downstream instability and performance degradation observed in DPO. See Appendix A for the full list of style features considered and additional details.

blocks.en: Directly intervening on these features during training would establish a causal link with downstream performance, but doing so is impractical on a large, diverse dataset like olmo2-1b-prefmix , where the relevant spurious features vary across domains and cannot be enumerated or controlled in advance. We therefore test the mechanism indirectly: if these shortcuts stem from generator-dependent biases, increasing generator diversity without an external judge should weaken them and improve performance.
blocks.zh: 在培训期间直接干预这些特征将建立与下游绩效的因果关系,但在olmo2-1b-prefmix等大型、多样的数据集上这样做是不切实际的,因为相关虚假特征在不同领域各不相同,无法事先列举或控制。 因此,我们间接检验这一机制:如果这些捷径来自依赖发电机的偏见,在没有外部法官的情况下增加发电机的多样性,就应削弱这些捷径,提高性能。

blocks.en: 3.4 Increasing Generators Diversity
blocks.zh: 3.4 增加发电机的多样性

blocks.en: Having shown that a single generator pair is suboptimal, we now ask the complementary question: is increasing generator diversity alone, without an external judge, enough to mitigate the problem? Proposition 2 predicts that drawing chosen and rejected completions from a larger pool of generators should weaken the shortcut of Proposition 1 . We therefore primarily compare against the single-pair baseline rather than against the original olmo2-1b-prefmix , which also differs in its ranking criterion. Our goal is not to close the gap with judge-supervised data, but to test whether diversity by itself yields a consistent improvement over single pairs. Note however that this approach is incremental: multi-model generation is a prerequisite for judge-based ranking, allowing practitioners to incorporate an external judge if needed.
blocks.zh: 在表明一对发电机不够理想之后,我们现在问一个补充性问题:单靠发电机的多样性,没有外部法官,是否足以缓解这一问题? 提议2预测,从更大的发电机库中选取和拒绝完成的绘图应削弱提议1的捷径。 因此,我们主要比较单页基线,而不是最初的olmo2-1b-prefmix,后者的排名标准也不同. 我们的目标不是用法官监督的数据缩小差距,而是检验多样性本身是否比单对数据得到持续改善。 但请注意,这种方法是渐进的:多模式生成是法官排名的先决条件,允许从业人员在需要时纳入一名外部法官。

blocks.en: Moving beyond a single model family breaks the size-based heuristic, since parameter count no longer reliably predicts completion quality across families (e.g., Gemma2-2B-it outperforms Qwen1.5-4B-Chat despite having half the parameters; Table 5 ). Using a judge would confound generators diversity with ranking criterion, potentially altering the choice even within a family. Therefore we assume access to benchmarks that proxy models’ relative performance on the training domains. This holds for olmo2-1b-prefmix , which is mainly composed of Instruction Following, Math and Coding data, so we rank models by their performance on IFEval, GSM8K and MBPP. We divide them into three tiers (high, mid, low) and, for each example, sample one of the pairings (high, mid), (high, low) or (mid, low), then draw one model uniformly from each tier. The result is a dataset whose completions come from nine different models. We note that it is the diversity of generators, not the benchmark-guided ranking, that Proposition 2 predicts will attenuate the bias; the ranking only replaces the size heuristic as a source of chosen/rejected ordering.
blocks.zh: 超越单一模式的家族打破了基于尺寸的热度,因为参数计数不再可靠地预测各个家庭的完成质量(例如,Gemma2-2B-it的成绩超过了Quen1.5-4B-Chat,尽管有一半的参数;表5)。 使用法官将使产生者的多样性与排名标准相混淆,甚至有可能改变家庭内部的选择。 因此,我们假定可以获得代理模型在培训领域的相对业绩基准。 这为olmo2-1b-prefmix所持有,它主要由指令跟随,数学和编码数据组成,因此我们根据模型在IFEval,GSM8K和MBPP上的性能来排序模型. 我们把它们分为三个等级(高,中,低),并且每个等级都抽样一个配对(高,中),(高,低)或(中,低),然后从每个等级中统一抽取一个模型. 结果是一个数据集,它的完成来自九个不同的模型. 我们注意到,由于发电机的多样性,而不是基准指导的排名,提议2预测会减少偏差;排名仅取代大小的热度,作为选择/拒绝命令的来源。

blocks.en: Since the ranking benchmarks also belong to our evaluation suite, we clarify that this is not data leakage, which would require test-set information to reach the training data through sample overlap or sample-level statistics. Neither occurs: the prompts in olmo2-1b-prefmix contain no sample from these benchmarks, and the benchmarks are used only to rank the generators by aggregate domain-level performance, a property of the models rather than of any test sample. The coarse ranking decides which model writes each completion, but carries no information about the benchmark samples themselves.
blocks.zh: 由于排名基准也属于我们的评价套件,我们澄清说,这不是数据泄漏,这就需要测试套件信息通过样本重叠或样本级统计到达培训数据. 两者都不发生:olmo2-1b-prefmix中的提示不包含这些基准的样本,基准仅用于按照集合域级性能排列生成器,这是模型而不是任何测试样本的属性. 粗细的排名决定了每个完成时哪个模型写作,但没有包含基准样本本身的信息.

blocks.en: Figure 5 shows that, relative to the average single pair, increasing generator diversity improves the average score for three of the four trained models. The effect is largest for Qwen2-1.5B-Instruct and Gemma2-2B-it , where average gains grow from + 0.55 % +0.55\% to + 1.45 % +1.45\% and from + 0.82 % +0.82\% to + 2.00 % +2.00\% , with IFEval gains of up to + 6.36 % +6.36\% and + 8.63 % +8.63\% respectively. For Qwen1.5-4B-Chat the average gain is smaller ( + 0.15 % +0.15\% to + 0.54 % +0.54\% ), but IFEval improves from − 0.05 % -0.05\% to + 9.11 % +9.11\% . For Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2 , the average does not improve ( + 0.14 % +0.14\% vs. + 0.06 % +0.06\% ), although IFEval gains persist. The benefit is therefore not uniform across models, and the improvement remains well below that of the judge-supervised dataset. Still, the consistent gain on instruction following, together with the average gains for most models, is what Proposition 2 predicts for a pipeline that only changes generator diversity. blocks.en: 4 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 4 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we have conducted a thorough analysis of the impact of the data generation process on training with Direct Preference Optimization (DPO). We focus on two approaches: the standard and computationally expensive strategy of generating completions from multiple models and ranking them using an LLM-as-a-judge, and the recently proposed alternative of using two models from the same family and deterministically defining preferences based on their relative size.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们透彻分析了数据生成过程对直接优化培训的影响。 我们侧重于两种方法:从多种模型中生成完成数据并使用LLM-as-judge进行排名的标准和计算成本战略,以及最近提出的使用来自同一家庭的两个模型并根据它们的相对规模确定偏好的其他方法。

blocks.en: Through an extensive theoretical and empirical analysis, we show that the two-model approach consistently underperforms, regardless of the model family or size used for either the generator models or the model being trained. We further show that this degradation is consistent with systematic, generator-dependent biases introduced by the limited and homogeneous set of generators, which can dominate the preference signal and hinder useful learning; chosen and rejected completions from a single pair can, in some settings, be separated almost perfectly using stylistic features alone.
blocks.zh: 通过广泛的理论和经验分析,我们表明,无论发电机模型或正在培训的模型所使用的模型家族或大小,两种模式方法的业绩始终不佳。 我们进一步表明,这种退化与有限和单一的发电机组所引入的系统化、依赖发电机的偏差是一致的,这种偏差可以支配偏好信号,并阻碍有益的学习;从一对发电机中选择和拒绝的完成,在某些环境下,仅用结构特征就可以几乎完全分开。

blocks.en: Finally, we directly test whether simply increasing generator diversity, without an external judge, can mitigate this effect. Since parameter size no longer predicts completion quality once generators span multiple families, we instead use coarse, benchmark-derived tiers to construct diverse pairs. This approach improves performance over the single-pair baseline for most models tested supporting the previous theoretical and empirical analysis. Taken together, our results indicate that generator diversity, is a critical factor behind the effectiveness of multi-model preference data.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们直接检验,在没有外部法官的情况下,仅仅增加发电机的多样性是否能够减轻这种影响。 由于参数大小不再预测一旦发电机跨过多个家庭的完成质量,我们反而使用粗糙,基准衍生的等级来构建不同的对. 这种方法改进了大多数经测试的模型的业绩,这些模型支持了以前的理论和经验分析。 总而言之,我们的结果表明,产生者的多样性是多种模式偏好数据效力的关键因素。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Although our experiments cover a wide range of models for both data generation and training, a potential limitation is that the largest models considered for training have 8 billion parameters, consistent with the scale explored in the paper introducing the delta learning hypothesis ( Geng et al., 2025 ) . Our theoretical results are agnostic to model scale, so we expect the underlying mechanism to hold at larger scales as well. A possible direction for future work is therefore to validate whether our findings continue to hold at larger scales.
blocks.zh: 虽然我们的实验涵盖了数据生成和培训的广泛模型,但潜在的局限性是,考虑培训的最大模型有80亿个参数,这与介绍三角洲学习假说的文件(Geng等人,2025年)所探讨的规模是一致的。 我们的理论结果对模型规模是不可知的,因此我们期望基本机制也能在更大的尺度上维持下去。 因此,今后工作的一个可能方向是验证我们的调查结果是否继续维持在更大的规模。

blocks.en: Appendix D Data Generation
blocks.zh: 附录D 数据生成

blocks.en: This section provides a complete overview of data generation and explains how the datasets are constructed.
blocks.zh: 本节全面概述数据生成情况,并解释数据集的构造方式.

blocks.en: D.1 Settings
blocks.zh: D.1 设置

blocks.en: We generate all data using vLLM ( Kwon et al., 2023 ) with the following parameters: top_p =0.9, temperature =0.2, thinking disabled, and max_new_tokens =2048. We discard truncated completions to avoid introducing truncation bias. The same generation parameters are used across all models. All other generation parameters are set to their default values.
blocks.zh: 我们使用 vLLM (Kwon et al., 2023) 生成所有数据, 参数如下: top_p = 0.9, 温度 = 0.2, 思维已禁用, max_new_tokens = 2048. 我们丢掉断线完成器,以避免产生断线偏差。 在所有模型中都使用同一生成参数。 其他所有生成参数都设定为默认值.

blocks.en: Then given the observed improvement, we enlarge the pool of models. However this is non-trivial, since as we add more models from different families the delta size heuristic fails to actually correlate with the quality of the completions. For example, as shown in Table 5 , Gemma2-2B-it significantly outperforms Qwen1.5-4B-Chat despite having half the parameter count. For this reason, we use roughly the same models used when constructing the original olmo2-1b-prefmix which differ greatly by their abilities and allow establishing deltas more easily. We evaluate models across Math, Instruction-Following, and Coding benchmarks as proxies for expected completion quality on olmo2-1b-prefmix given its composition (see Table 9 for benchmark scores).

blocks.en: Appendix E More Training Details
blocks.zh: 附录E 更多培训详情

blocks.en: We implement our training pipeline using the Hugging Face ecosystem, primarily relying on the Transformers Reinforcement Learning (TRL) library. We use DeepSpeed ( Aminabadi et al., 2022 ) and its implementation of ZeRO ( Rajbhandari et al., 2020 ) , selecting the ZeRO stage according to model size. All experiments are conducted on a single node equipped with 8 H100 GPUs. We use olmo2-1b-prefmix as the baseline for all experiments and we replace the original completions while keeping the underlying prompt distribution fixed. Our setup closely matches the training configuration of OLMo2-1B-SFT , for which the baseline dataset was originally designed.
blocks.zh: 我们主要依靠变形器强化学习(TRL)图书馆,利用Hugging Face生态系统实施我们的培训管道。 我们使用DeepSpeed(Aminabadi等人,2022年)及其执行ZeRO(Rajbhandari等人,2020年),根据模型大小选择ZeRO阶段. 所有实验都在一个配备8台H100GPU的单一节点上进行. 我们使用olmo2-1b-prefmix作为所有实验的基线,我们替换原来的完成,同时保持基础的即时分布固定. 我们的设置与OLMo2-1B-SFT的训练配置紧密匹配,其基准数据集最初就是为此设计的.

blocks.en: Across all experiments, we train for 1,000 optimization steps with an effective batch size of 128 and a maximum sequence length of 2,048 tokens. We use a linear learning-rate scheduler with a warmup ratio of 0.1 0.1 . For optimization, we use AdamW ( Loshchilov and Hutter, 2019 ) with β 1 = 0.9 \beta_{1}=0.9 , β 2 = 0.999 \beta_{2}=0.999 , and ϵ = 10 − 8 \epsilon=10^{-8} . This fixed training budget and shared configuration provide a consistent basis for comparing performance across experimental settings.
blocks.zh: 在所有实验中,我们训练1000个优化步骤,有效批量尺寸128个,最大序列长度2,048个令牌. 我们使用线性学习率计时器,热量比为0.1-0.1. 为了优化,我们使用AdamW(Loshchilov和Hutter,2019年),其中β 1 = 0.9\βa_{1}=0.9,β 2 = 0.999\βa_{2}=0.999, + 10 = 8\epsilon= 10^{-8}. 这种固定的培训预算和共享配置为比较各种实验环境的业绩提供了一个一致的基础。

blocks.en: We sweep the regularization parameter β ∈ { 5 , 10 } \beta\in\{5,10\} and adjust the learning-rate grid according to the dataset used. For the original olmo2-1b-prefmix , we sweep learning rates in { 1 × 10 − 6 , 5 × 10 − 7 , 1 × 10 − 7 } \{1\times 10^{-6},5\times 10^{-7},1\times 10^{-7}\} . In the initial experiments reported in Table 5 and some of the ablations in Table 6 , we used the same grid for generated completions. However, we observed that a learning rate of 1 × 10 − 6 1\times 10^{-6} often caused substantial performance degradation, while the best results were frequently obtained with 1 × 10 − 7 1\times 10^{-7} . We therefore expanded the search toward lower learning rates to enable a fairer comparison across data sources and avoid systematically disadvantaging generated completions. Specifically, for our generated completions, we use { 5 × 10 − 7 , 1 × 10 − 7 , 5 × 10 − 8 , 1 × 10 − 8 } \{5\times 10^{-7},1\times 10^{-7},5\times 10^{-8},1\times 10^{-8}\} , as higher learning rates on pairs constructed using the delta-size heuristic consistently led to severe performance degradation, in some cases causing performance to fall below the SFT baseline. This sensitivity further supports the claim that training on a single model pair substantially alters the training dynamics, as discussed in Section 3.3.1 .
